archetypes.name: probe-parity
archetypes.rationale: Reviewer probe behavior migrated from Bash has many cache and auth edge cases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python health-probe implementation against the retired Bash contract. Focus on stamp TTL handling, auth retry classification, Codex env-key versus login isolation, Cursor preflight behavior, and emitted KV ordering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Many shell, skill, and docs surfaces now route through new CLI verbs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the call-site cutover from retired scripts to python/cli.py agent verbs. Check health-gate retry semantics, status parsing, registry harness stubs, Makefile target compatibility, and stale retired-script references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
